title: The report guard reads a spawn with no model field as the role's frontmatter model, not as sonnet
why: Coordinator 12:32 CST Nov 8, from lane silent-undo-checks-pr-base (12:31 CST): the report guard's model-name check reads a reviewer or test-author spawn with no model field as sonnet, but agents/reviewer.md and agents/test-author.md set model: haiku and the agents report claude-haiku-5-5. It blocks true "reviewer haiku" Done lines; the records on #1869 and #2136 say sonnet wrongly. Fix: the guard reads the role's frontmatter model when the spawn names none, with one home, the agents/*.md file. Related: agent-model-unnamed-spawn (done; the spawn guard).
note: Coordinator 12:36 CST Nov 8: the fix is already on main (d77b57393, 2026-11-04); the lane adds two green tests only. Likely cause: a session ran a stale installed ~/.claude (659 commits behind at session start) or had CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL set; the lane measures which. Possible false alarm, same check (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85, 14:26 and 14:37 CST Nov 8): it said no model was named for a reviewer on Done items that named only (test-author haiku, builder sonnet) and had no reviewer; each Done item opened a draft PR whose round 1 had just started, and reviewer appeared only under Next. Guess: the check takes review roles from the whole report or the PR, not from the Done item. Workaround used: add "reviewer haiku: round 1 is still running" to the Done item. Coordinator 15:29 CST Nov 8: steps report-guard-role-default-model and model-guard-default-model fold into this lane, with the #2260 incident (a false round 1 model written into a review record). Draft #2307 (merge after #2282; coordinator 16:30 CST Nov 8) fixes the cause: the model check read only the spawns after the last human message, so it missed earlier ones. When #2307 merges, close this step and steps report-guard-role-default-model and model-guard-default-model.
